recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆嗜中性球，其中左側細胞在核葉旁的細胞質內有一至兩顆小而圓、深紫色、與核染色一致的點狀包涵體，外觀類似紅血球的 Howell-Jolly body；背景紅血球多呈棘狀（crenation），多屬抹片乾燥假影。
features: Two mature neutrophils with segmented nuclei and fine pink-lilac cytoplasmic granules
Left neutrophil contains small, round, dense dark-purple inclusions in the cytoplasm adjacent to the nuclear lobes, staining like nuclear chromatin
Right neutrophil shows a lobulated nucleus with clumped chromatin without a clearly separate inclusion
Numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes), consistent with drying/storage artifact
Scattered normal-appearing platelets; no blasts in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature neutrophils with normal cytoplasmic granulation. One neutrophil contains small, round, dense, dark-purple cytoplasmic inclusions separate from the main nuclear lobes, resembling Howell-Jolly bodies (detached nuclear fragments). The background red cells show prominent crenation consistent with smear or storage artifact, and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions in neutrophils, a nonspecific finding reported with immunosuppressive or cytotoxic therapy (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus, chemotherapy), HIV infection, and transplantation; correlation with medication history is recommended.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale grey-blue, irregular, peripheral cytoplasmic patches of rough ER rather than dense, round, chromatin-colored dots.
A drumstick is attached to a nuclear lobe by a thin chromatin strand, whereas Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions lie free in the cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed bacteria or organisms (e.g., Ehrlichia/Anaplasma morulae)
ddx.vs: Morulae are stippled clusters of basophilic granules and bacteria are rod- or coccus-shaped, unlike solitary smooth round nuclear fragments.
Apoptotic cells show multiple uniformly pyknotic, round nuclear fragments with condensed cytoplasm rather than an otherwise normal segmented nucleus with a small detached fragment.
